note: Each case is one real argv array as it would be handed to an ExecuteProcess or read from /proc/<pid>/cmdline. Expected RosArgs live in tests/fixtures/expected/static/ros_args.json, keyed by the same name. argv_arrays.json holds the same arrays in the same order without the names.

cases.name: plain_only
cases.note: no --ros-args at all, everything is leftover

cases.name: node_name_remap
cases.note: the canonical way a node gets its name from argv

cases.name: legacy_assignments
cases.note: ROS 1 style bare assignments with no --ros-args block

cases.name: params_file_repeated
cases.note: order is load bearing and duplicates are kept

cases.name: typed_params
cases.note: typed values stay raw strings, typing is the consumer's job

cases.name: param_long_form
cases.note: a repeated name is kept twice in order, last wins downstream

cases.name: topic_remaps
cases.note: the third form is a node prefixed remap and keeps its prefix

cases.name: log_level_and_enclave
cases.note: log level keeps its raw spelling, last one wins

cases.name: double_dash_tail
cases.note: double dash closes the ros-args block, the tail is leftover

cases.name: everything_at_once
cases.note: every recognised form in one argv

cases.name: malformed_missing_value
cases.note: flag at end of argv with nothing to consume

cases.name: malformed_no_separator
cases.note: assignments with no := and a params-file with no path

cases.name: malformed_empty_and_unknown
cases.note: empty token, empty names, unknown flag, none of it may raise
